data.title: Hale at the Gate
data.description: Hale is fighting Skarn Ashfang of the Ashen Fang raiders, a rifle in one hand and a hatchet in the other. The raiders press hard and the mood is desperate. This took place by the east gate, under a clear sky. This image represents the events of the 11th of Septober, 5503.

tale.summary: Hale fought Skarn Ashfang's raiders at the east gate

data.title: The Last Row
data.description: Old Odo is lying among rice stalks with Dee kneeling beside him. The mood is peaceful but sad. This took place in the rice field, in light rain. This image represents the events of the 11th of Septober, 5503.

tale.summary: Old Odo died of old age beside his rice

data.title: Hale Falls
data.description: Hale is falling backward, shot through the chest, while Mirel Dask of the Salt Hounds lowers a rifle. The mood is shocking and grim. This took place behind the barricade, in thick smoke. This image represents the events of the 11th of Septober, 5503.

tale.summary: Hale was shot down by a Salt Hound raider

data.title: The Thrumbo
data.description: A thrumbo is charging across a snow field while Hale braces a spear against the ground. The mood is tense and proud. This took place on the northern plain, in light snow. This image represents the events of the 2th of Septober, 5503.

tale.summary: Hale brought down a charging thrumbo

data.title: Two Colonists
data.description: Cy and Kit are grappling in the dirt, Kit's fist raised and Cy's lip bleeding. The mood is bitter. This took place in the courtyard, on a hot, dry morning. This image represents the events of the 11th of Septober, 5503.

tale.summary: Cy and Kit came to blows over the stolen rifle

data.title: Where We Landed
data.description: Three escape pods are burning in a field of yellow grass, with Ana, Bram and Dee crawling clear. The mood is dazed and hopeful. This took place in the open grassland, under a heavy sky. This image represents the events of the 7th of Aprimay, 5503.

tale.summary: The first group landed in escape pods

data.title: Wind Over the Barn
data.description: Bram and Kit are holding a sheet of roofing down against the wind as lightning splits the sky. The mood is frantic. This took place on the barn roof, in a violent thunderstorm. This image represents the events of the 8th of Septober, 5503.

tale.summary: A thunderstorm tore the roof off the barn
